summary: Prove doctor to verify against a synthetic media stack
description: Run the final release gate over the complete real local container stack plus deterministic doubles: broken scenario through inventory, doctor, plan, approval, apply, API readback, verify, redacted evidence, reset, and healthy inventory.
acceptance: A synthetic misconfiguration is diagnosed, planned, applied, and verified end to end.
A stale-plan scenario and an unauthorized destructive scenario fail closed.
Proof artifacts contain no secrets, network identifiers, media titles, or runtime paths.
The proof uses real local Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, qBittorrent, and Jellyfin containers plus repository-owned deterministic doubles.
Reset leaves no matching marked resources and the rebuilt healthy inventory matches the canonical baseline.
